nodes.description: mapping(uint256 => address) tokenOwner: owner of each token ID
mapping(uint256 => address) tokenApprovals: approved address per token ID
mapping(address => uint256) ownedTokensCount: token balance per owner
mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) operatorApprovals: operator permissions
mapping(address => uint256[]) ownedTokens: enumerable token list per owner
mapping(uint256 => uint256) ownedTokensIndex: index of token in owner list
uint256[] allTokens: global list of all token IDs
mapping(uint256 => uint256) allTokensIndex: index of token in allTokens
mapping(uint256 => string) tokenURIs: metadata URI per token ID
Token[] private tokens: Nfties monster metadata array
mapping(bytes4 => bool) supportedInterfaces: ERC165 lookup table
create(): mints a random Nfties monster to msg.sender and sets its URI
get(uint256): returns owner and monster metadata for a token ID
tokensOfOwner(address): returns token IDs owned by an address
createTokenUri(uint8 x5): builds the monster image URI string
appendUint8ToString(string,uint8): appends decimal digits of a uint8
strConcat(string,string): concatenates two strings
_mint(address,uint256): internal mint adding token to owner and global list
_burn(address,uint256): internal burn clearing metadata and list entries
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): moves token ownership after authorization
safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256): 3-arg overload delegating to 4-arg
safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256,bytes): transfer plus receiver check
approve(address,uint256): sets approved address for a token
setApprovalForAll(address,bool): grants/revokes operator rights
isApprovedForAll(address,address): operator permission query
isApprovedOrOwner(address,uint256): authorization check helper
checkAndCallSafeTransfer(address,address,uint256,bytes): external receiver callback
addTokenTo(address,uint256): assigns ownership and indexes token lists
removeTokenFrom(address,uint256): clears ownership and compacts lists
clearApproval(address,uint256): resets approved address for a token
balanceOf(address): returns token balance of an owner
ownerOf(uint256): returns owner address of a token
exists(uint256): returns whether a token has an owner
getApproved(uint256): returns approved address of a token
tokenURI(uint256): returns metadata URI of a token
tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address,uint256): enumeration lookup by owner
tokenByIndex(uint256): enumeration lookup by global index
totalSupply(): returns number of minted tokens
_setTokenURI(uint256,string): stores metadata URI for an existing token
_registerInterface(bytes4): marks an ERC165 interface as supported
supportsInterface(bytes4): ERC165 query using the lookup table
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address
ERC721Receiver(_to).onERC721Received external call made after state mutation
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(totalSupply(), blockhash(block.number-1))) weak randomness
direct array length decrement (ownedTokens[_from].length--, allTokens.length--) without SafeMath
SafeMath.add used for ownedTokensCount balance update
_from: source address parameter of transferFrom
_to: destination address parameter of transferFrom
_tokenId: token identifier parameter of transferFrom
_owner: address parameter of balanceOf
_index: index parameter of tokenOfOwnerByIndex
_operator: operator address parameter of isApprovedForAll
_approved: boolean approval flag of setApprovalForAll
_interfaceId: ERC165 interface id parameter of _registerInterface
_spender: address checked in isApprovedOrOwner
_data: extra bytes forwarded to the receiver callback
_uri: metadata URI string parameter of _setTokenURI
body: monster body attribute derived from pseudo random bytes
feet: monster feet attribute derived from pseudo random bytes
head: monster head attribute derived from pseudo random bytes
mouth: monster mouth attribute derived from pseudo random bytes
extra: monster extra attribute derived from pseudo random bytes
tokenUri: memory string produced by createTokenUri in create()
_newToken: Token struct pushed into tokens array in create()
sudoRandomButTotallyPredictable: keccak256 hash used as weak randomness source

edges.reason: blockhash-derived pseudo random value is consumed by create() to pick monster attributes
weak random hash is stored in local sudoRandomButTotallyPredictable
create() pushes the new Token struct into the private tokens array
create() calls createTokenUri() to build the metadata string
create() calls _mint() to assign the new token
create() calls _setTokenURI() to store the token URI
create() uses msg.sender as the owner of the new token
msg.sender is passed to _mint() as the beneficiary
createTokenUri() calls appendUint8ToString() for each attribute
createTokenUri() calls strConcat() to join URI segments
_setTokenURI() writes the tokenURIs mapping
_setTokenURI() calls exists() to validate the token
_mint() calls addTokenTo() to register ownership
addTokenTo() writes the tokenOwner mapping
addTokenTo() uses SafeMath.add to increment the owner balance
SafeMath.add result is stored in ownedTokensCount
_burn() calls removeTokenFrom() to clear ownership
_burn() calls clearApproval() to reset approvals
_burn() compacts and rewrites the global allTokens array
_burn() decrements allTokens.length directly without SafeMath
removeTokenFrom() decrements ownedTokens[_from].length unchecked
removeTokenFrom() subtracts one from ownedTokensCount
removeTokenFrom() clears the tokenOwner entry
clearApproval() resets the tokenApprovals entry to zero
transferFrom() calls isApprovedOrOwner() before moving the token
isApprovedOrOwner() validates msg.sender against owner and approvals
transferFrom() calls clearApproval() on the transferred token
transferFrom() calls removeTokenFrom() for the previous owner
transferFrom() calls addTokenTo() for the new owner
transferFrom() uses msg.sender for the authorization check
safeTransferFrom(3 args) delegates to the 4-argument overload
safeTransferFrom(4 args) calls transferFrom() to move the token
safeTransferFrom(4 args) calls checkAndCallSafeTransfer() after state changes
checkAndCallSafeTransfer() makes an external call to the receiver's onERC721Received
the receiver callback returns control to checkAndCallSafeTransfer()
approve() calls ownerOf() to resolve the token owner
approve() calls isApprovedForAll() to allow operators
approve() writes the tokenApprovals mapping
approve() requires msg.sender to be owner or approved operator
ownerOf() reads the tokenOwner mapping
setApprovalForAll() writes operatorApprovals
setApprovalForAll() keys operatorApprovals by msg.sender
isApprovedForAll() reads operatorApprovals
balanceOf() reads ownedTokensCount
exists() reads tokenOwner to test for zero address
getApproved() reads tokenApprovals
tokenURI() reads tokenURIs
tokenURI() calls exists() to validate the token
tokenOfOwnerByIndex() reads ownedTokens
tokenOfOwnerByIndex() calls balanceOf() for bounds checking
tokenByIndex() reads the allTokens array
totalSupply() reads the allTokens array length
get() reads tokenOwner for the requested token
get() reads the tokens metadata array
tokensOfOwner() reads the ownedTokens mapping
_registerInterface() writes supportedInterfaces
supportsInterface() reads supportedInterfaces
checkAndCallSafeTransfer() forwards msg.sender to the external receiver
the _data bytes parameter is forwarded into the external receiver call
_from parameter flows into transferFrom()
_to parameter flows into transferFrom()
_tokenId parameter flows into transferFrom()
_spender parameter is compared against the owner in isApprovedOrOwner()
_approved parameter is written into operatorApprovals
_interfaceId parameter is registered in supportedInterfaces
_uri parameter is stored into the tokenURIs mapping
local tokenUri is passed to _setTokenURI()
local _newToken struct is pushed into the tokens array by create()
